attributes.context: The surrounding text describes layoff and displacement rights and procedures, including termination of probationary employees, seniority-based displacement, qualification and orientation requirements, company notification, and recall rights, which appear to be the 'rights under this section' referenced by the technological-change sentence.

extraction_text: Employees affected by technological change exercising their rights under this section within their department will be considered as having utilized their right under Article 7(o).

attributes.context: This text appears in Article 7, titled Technological Changes, Workloads, Rates and Wages, after the parties state that wage payment plans should be understandable and that fair day's work for a fair day's pay is important to morale, productivity, quality, and business.

extraction_text: The parties hereto recognize that for the purpose of providing more efficient operation of the plants and thereby keeping the Company in a competitive position in the industry, it is necessary from time to time to (1) install new and modern machinery, (2) develop new machines, (3) develop improvements for machinery, (4) develop new methods, manufacturing processes and techniques, (5) make changes in materials processed or quality or manufacturing standards, (6) create new jobs or revise or combine existing jobs and establish wage rates therefore, and (7) make time and motion studies and adjust piece rates and workloads on piece work jobs and workloads on day work jobs so that they will conform to the provisions of paragraphs (d) and (e) of this Article 7.

(o) Employees displaced by reason of technological or other changes or workload changes shall be eligible for preferred hiring in such jobs as they may be qualified to perform, subject to the seniority provisions of this Agreement in the plant in which they were displaced.
